name: M15 Wilder RSI extreme-entry continuation and fade screening batch

source_references.citation: Perry J. Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods; frozen backlog cites an unspecified edition at pages 389-390 for short-horizon RSI context
source_references.supports: Wiley verifies current bibliographic metadata only. The cited pages were not opened and do not establish this RSI(14) M15 FX transition rule or cost-aware profitability.

research.evidence_summary: The fixed Wilder RSI(14), 70/30 entry rule is a compact speculative operationalization of weak book context. Both continuation and fade signs are tested; no profitable effect is claimed.

feasibility.rationale: Uses only causally completed M15 closes, deterministic Wilder recurrences, prior ATR, supported fills/stops and same-day exits. V2 compatibility remains unconfirmed.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with at least 98 valid observed M15 closes through t; event bars t-1 and t must be physically adjacent
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require 15 consecutive unique valid candles per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; duplicates invalidate aggregation
For each observed close change d_i set gain_i=max(d_i,0) and loss_i=max(-d_i,0)
Seed Wilder average gain/loss at change 14 as arithmetic means of the first 14 observed gains/losses; thereafter avg_t=(13*avg_{t-1}+value_t)/14
Compute observed-sequence TR from previous observed close, seed Wilder ATR(96) from first 96 valid TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, freeze ATR through t-1
Routine elapsed gaps remain represented in observed-sequence indicator changes; only t-1/t must be physically adjacent
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: Thresholds and horizon have no inspected direct M15 FX support
RSI extremes may describe trend rather than predict response
Six correlated symbols/four cells are not independent

hypothesis.behavior: The first completed M15 close that moves Wilder RSI(14) into an upper or lower extreme may continue with the oscillator direction or fade over 30-60 minutes.
hypothesis.mechanism: Extreme oscillator entry could reflect persistent directional order flow or short-horizon exhaustion.
works_when: RSI state entry marks a meaningful change rather than a persistent label
One response sign survives both holds and costs
fails_when: Extreme entry arrives after the move
falsifiable_predictions: Both hold cells for one response mode are positive normal/doubled
The 60-minute center is positive in both UTC halves and at least three symbols
Both cells survive common five-date removal

definitions.name: wilder_gain_loss
definitions.formula: g_i=max(close_i-close_{i-1},0), l_i=max(close_{i-1}-close_i,0); seed AG14=mean(g_1..g_14), AL14=mean(l_1..l_14); recur AG_i=(13*AG_{i-1}+g_i)/14 and AL_i=(13*AL_{i-1}+l_i)/14

definitions.name: rsi14
definitions.formula: if AG=AL=0 then 50; else if AL=0 then 100; else if AG=0 then 0; else 100-100/(1+AG/AL)
definitions.timing: Compute RSI_{t-1} and RSI_t after their respective completed closes

definitions.name: extreme_entry_direction
definitions.formula: +1 iff RSI_{t-1}<70 AND RSI_t>=70; -1 iff RSI_{t-1}>30 AND RSI_t<=30; otherwise 0
definitions.timing: Known at completed t close; t-1/t physically adjacent

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) through t-1 over valid observed true ranges
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal t; require finite positive

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: extreme_entry_direction for FOLLOW_EXTREME and -extreme_entry_direction for FADE_EXTREME

entries.long_condition: eligible extreme entry AND ((direction=+1 AND FOLLOW_EXTREME) OR (direction=-1 AND FADE_EXTREME)) AND cell flat
entries.short_condition: eligible extreme entry AND ((direction=-1 AND FOLLOW_EXTREME) OR (direction=+1 AND FADE_EXTREME)) AND cell flat
entries.signal_time: Close of London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes<=15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at final M1 chart/bid close of completed t; V2 applies resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage. Entry candle cannot trigger new stop; management starts next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell

Persistent same-side RSI at or beyond 70 (or at or below 30) cannot retrigger until it first returns strictly inside that same threshold and later re-enters. A direct transition from the opposite extreme into the other threshold qualifies as that other threshold's first entry under extreme_entry_direction

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-atr96_prior; short=signal_close_bid+atr96_prior. Long triggers bid, short executable ask; adverse gaps fill at worse executable open with costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails affected cells; valid due bar resolves STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No entry matures after 15:00; post-entry defects fail only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns isolated portfolio; same-timestamp symbols within cell size from common pre-entry equity so chart stop risk is 0.25% before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell at most six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no cap shared across four portfolios
risk.leverage: Use lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip unrepresentable size
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell one per symbol and six total; four cells independently track all state

experiment.baseline: Wilder RSI14 entry through 70/30/one-ATR stop; FOLLOW_EXTREME; hold=60
robustness_tests: Report all four cells and retain full breadth ledger
Report symbols and UTC-midpoint halves; midpoint close belongs first half
Double spread, commission and slippage individually
For each mode center hold=60 remove five best normal-cost London dates from both hold cells; require both normal/doubled net R positive
For both cells use eligible London weekdays including zeros and 10000 circular five-date bootstrap resamples seed 2026018; center lower bound must exceed zero
Mode advances only if hold=60 center and hold=30 neighbor both pass
Report upper/lower transition counts and zero-denominator convention counts
costs: Use resolved/fallback spread, commission and slippage at each fill
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical transitions
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 332 selectable R007-R018 cells, two R008 diagnostics, and named RSI, oscillator-extreme, close-streak and exhaustion trials including I-03 and I-40. Cross-batch promotion uses full ledger; incomplete IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds positive normal/doubled
Reject if center non-positive either UTC half or fewer than three symbols positive each half
Reject if center fewer than 300 trades
Reject if five-date removal makes either cell non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound not above zero
Reject promotion on required-cell data failure
Never access holdout without explicit authorization for separately frozen version

pseudocode: Build valid London M15 bars causally.
Maintain observed-sequence Wilder gain/loss recurrences and ATR96 through t-1.
After completed t update RSI14 using current close change.
Trigger only strict-inside to inclusive-extreme transition on adjacent t-1/t.
Map follow/fade and enter flat cells at signal close.
From next M1 process stop before due exit; fail only affected cells.
Publish four cells and full robustness/ledger rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: RSI prior equality 70 cannot trigger upper entry and equality 30 cannot trigger lower entry
zero close change contributes zero gain/loss
event-pair gap suppresses signal while routine earlier gaps remain in indicators
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol with Wilder indicator state and isolated four-cell portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 RSI recurrence, M15/fill and result-ledger compatibility confirmation
